About me

I’m a B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering student who spends most of his time where models meet constraints: limited GPU memory, noisy sensors, a delivery van with twelve stops.

My focus is AI/ML engineering — NLP, generative AI, deep learning and LLM optimization — backed by Python, C++ and the systems fundamentals that keep models running once they ship. I also build Android apps like Mitti Mitra, and wire sensors to ESP32 boards when a problem needs hardware.
